title: Reproducibility code for "Edge-cusped weak compactons in degenerate nonlinear dispersive equations"
description:
Python code that regenerates every figure, table, and numerical constant of the manuscript Edge-cusped weak compactons in degenerate nonlinear dispersive equations (F. R. Villatoro, submitted to Studies in Applied Mathematics, 2026).

generate_figures.py produces all figures and the residual and width data; verify_claims.py recomputes the closed-form constants of the paper to 30 digits with mpmath, by quadrature routes independent of the ODE integrator.
notes: Partially supported by the Universidad de Malaga, Spain, through project PPRO-B4-2026-004 of its Plan Propio de Investigacion, Transferencia y Divulgacion Cientifica.
